# Signal Pilot Docs

> Official documentation for Signal Pilot's 7 non-repainting TradingView indicators: Pentarch, OmniDeck, Janus Atlas, Augury Grid, Plutus Flow, Harmonic Oscillator, and Volume Oracle.

Signal Pilot is a suite of TradingView indicators designed for technical analysis. All indicators are guaranteed non-repainting. The documentation covers setup, configuration, alert creation, webhook integrations, and a 4-phase trading workflow (Bias, Timing, Execution, Management).

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start](https://docs.signalpilot.io/start-quick/): 5-minute setup guide to install and configure your first indicator
- [Prerequisites & Requirements](https://docs.signalpilot.io/start-prerequisites/): TradingView plan requirements and system prerequisites
- [7-Day Onboarding Checklist](https://docs.signalpilot.io/start-onboarding/): Structured onboarding plan for new users
- [Learning Path](https://docs.signalpilot.io/start-learning-path/): Progressive learning guide from beginner to advanced
- [Configuration Wizard](https://docs.signalpilot.io/configuration-wizard/): Interactive tool for configuring indicator settings

## Indicator Guides

- [Pentarch v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/pentarch-v10/): 5-cycle exhaustion and reversal detection system
- [OmniDeck v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/omnideck-v10/): All-in-one indicator with 10+ detection systems
- [Janus Atlas v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/janus-atlas-v10/): 50+ level types including VWAP, Fibonacci, Anchored VWAP, and session levels
- [Augury Grid v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/augury-grid-v10/): Multi-timeframe screener monitoring 7 symbols across 3 timeframes
- [Plutus Flow v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/plutus-flow-v10/): On-Balance Volume analysis with divergence detection
- [Harmonic Oscillator v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/harmonic-oscillator-v10/): 7-component momentum consensus system
- [Volume Oracle v1.0](https://docs.signalpilot.io/volume-oracle-v10/): Volume intelligence and regime detection
- [Suite Overview](https://docs.signalpilot.io/suite-index/): Overview and comparison of all 7 indicators

## How-To Guides

- [Setting Up Alerts](https://docs.signalpilot.io/how-to-alerts/): Configure TradingView alerts with Once Per Bar Close
- [Using Webhooks](https://docs.signalpilot.io/how-to-webhooks/): Send alerts to Discord, Telegram, and 3commas
- [Using the Screener](https://docs.signalpilot.io/how-to-screener/): Multi-symbol monitoring with Augury Grid
